HomeProjects

Projects

Here are links to some of the various projects that we do.

Bicycle ambulances

Ensuring people can get to a health service In our area of support there is a huge issue with lack of transport to hospital/clinics. There are not enough health centres/hospitals in our area and therefore the catchment area for each centre is huge.

Find out more

Building schools

Since 2006 we have completed a number of school building projects including a number of school blocks (typically with 6 classrooms) at various locations as well as five teachers’ houses, kitchens and store rooms. We also build and renovate pre-schools.

Find out more

Community Based Childcare Centres (CBCCs)

What is a CBCC? A CBCC is a building with a multiple use - as a pre-school and as a feeding station for children 3-5 years old. Most children in rural areas cannot access early learning opportunities through pre-schools and are ill-prepared when they start school.

Find out more

Distributions

Although we aim to build sustainable communities, unfortunately sometimes distributions, linked with our health projects are necessary. Some food is provided to those most in need, in the ‘hungry months’ around February before the harvest is ready.

Find out more

Feeding Programme in Schools

We have been working in partnership with ‘Feed The Children’ (www.feedthechildren.org) who provide the food and we organise the training and operation of the feeding programme.

Find out more

Funsani - Rammed Earth Community Based Childcare Centre (CBCC)

Gandys ‘Orphans for Orphans’ has funded a pre-school at Funsani, Lumbadzi Centre. The building was completed in September 2017 and was opened by Gandys in October.

Find out more

Maternity

1 in 6 women die in childbirth in Malawi. In April 2010 we filmed in our local Clinic and Maternity unit with 8 beds. These serve 13,569 people. There was one Medical Assistant and one Midwife to run the two units. The Midwife was pregnant.

Find out more

Project4Africa

Project4Africa is a group who raise funds to help various projects in Africa. In 2022, we are delighted to announce they will provide effective educational opportunities for children and adults with special educational needs and disabilities.

Find out more

Secondary School Sponsorship

Education is free to children up to the end of primary school but if theywant to go on and get a full education (and hopefully go onto university) it costsaround £792 for four years at Secondary School This pays for school fees, examfees, school materials, boarding fees, food and school uniform. We are currentlysponsoring 40 teenagers to go to Secondary school.

Water and Sanitation

It only costs £150 to build up a well to make it safe a free from contamination. This is a great present for your friends and family as it is genuinely saving lives and we will have a plaque created with the name of your recipient on it to go on the well - we will then take pictures of the well upon completion and send it to them.
